# Global AI Ping 0.7.1 — Preview
- Clicking outside the menu-bar popover now closes it, including clicks in other apps and the desktop. - Clicks inside the popover, native sound menus and the status icon retain their normal behavior. - Mouse monitors exist only while the popover is open; clicks are not consumed.
Apple silicon preview. Apple Developer ID signing and notarization are still pending.

# Global AI Ping 0.7.0 — Preview
- Guided first-run setup for Codex / Claude Code connections, system audio and launch at login. - Smooth transitions with Reduce Motion support. - Built-in Sparkle updates: manual checks, automatic daily checks, install now or later. - New-version indicator in the settings sidebar. - Signed update feed and Ed25519-verified downloads.
Requires macOS 14.2 or later for audio ducking. This first preview download is for Apple silicon. This preview is not yet Apple Developer ID signed or notarized; macOS may block first launch on another Mac. The in-app updater verifies downloads using the app's own pinned signing key. Existing installations before 0.7.0 require this version to be installed manually once.
